Usage

When to use. The attachment overflow menu appears when clicking the overflow attachment pill. It lists every grounded attachment as a row — type glyph, name, and source — with a Remove action per row. Dismiss with the header X. Reuses the Popover surface (Shadow/Highest), Button (dismiss + Remove), MenuListItem rows, and Avatar for people.
